\---

name: Feature Request

about: Propose a new capability or improvement

title: "\[FEATURE] "

labels: enhancement

assignees: ""

\---



\## Objective



Describe the requested feature or improvement.



\## Problem or Motivation



What problem would this solve?



\## Proposed Behavior



Describe how the feature should work.



\## Constraints



List any technical, compatibility, hardware, privacy, or performance constraints.



\## Acceptance Criteria



\- Requested behavior works

\- Relevant validation or tests pass

\- Existing functionality remains intact

\- Documentation is updated if needed

\- No private media, generated transcripts, secrets, or restricted files are introduced



\## Additional Context



Add examples, screenshots, references, or implementation notes if useful.
